nodes.label: Formulaic Alpha Library (101 Alphas)
nodes.rationale: 101 formulaic alphas (SSRN-2701346) for signal generation. Common interface: double[] compute(AlphaInputData). MegaAlphaEngine combines alphas via configurable weights with industry-neutralization.

nodes.label: Markov-Modulated Optimal Stops
nodes.rationale: Replace static stop-loss/take-profit with state-dependent levels from Markov-modulated diffusion (SSRN-2381830). Stop levels adjust in real-time as strategy moves through signal lifecycle.

nodes.label: Leverage Rotation Strategy (200-day MA)
nodes.rationale: Systematic rotation between leveraged equity and risk-free assets guided by S&P 500 200-day MA (SSRN-2741701). Rotates into T-bills during risk-off regimes.

nodes.label: Pairs Trading Verification (Orthogonal Signal)
nodes.rationale: Minimum-distance pairs (SSRN-141615) as orthogonal signal verification. Divergence between ILI signals and pairs signals indicates liquidity-driven market dislocation.

nodes.label: Portfolio Management Algebra
nodes.rationale: Standardized cost model: Trading costs = (t0 + t1)P + sP (SSRN-2314590). Margin call equation integrated into VirtualPortfolio rebalancing engine.
